content_sections.heading: SCL Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 83 vacancies have been advertised for administrative and technical posts to be filled on a regular basis. Reservation to eligible candidates shall be as per Government of India directives. Abbreviations: UR - Unreserved; EWS - Economically Weaker Section; OBC - Other Backward Classes; SC - Scheduled Caste; ST - Scheduled Tribe; PwBDs - Persons with Benchmark Disabilities; ESM - Ex-Servicemen.

content_sections.heading: SCL Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. For more details including eligibility, qualification and the discipline-specific requirements for each post, interested candidates are requested to visit the official SCL website at www.scl.gov.in/career.html.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for SCL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must apply online through the official portal at www.scl.gov.in/career.html. Online registration opens on 01.11.2026 at 11:00 AM and closes on 30.11.2026 at 05:00 PM. Any addendum or corrigendum related to the recruitment will be published exclusively on the SCL website.

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are announced in SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 83 regular vacancies have been announced across administrative and technical posts under advertisement SCL:01/2026.

faq.question: Q2. When does online registration start for SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Online registration begins on 1 November 2026 at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The closing date for online registration is 30 November 2026 at 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay level and approximate salary for Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: Technical Assistant is placed at Pay Level-7 with approximate total emoluments of Rs. 83,700 per month as per the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Technician 'B' in SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Technician 'B' is placed at Pay Level-3 with approximate total emoluments of Rs. 41,940 per month as per the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay level for Administrative Officer and Accounts Officer?
faq.answer: Both Administrative Officer and Accounts Officer posts are placed at Pay Level-10 with approximate total emoluments of Rs. 1,06,740 per month as per the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q7. Are the positions in SCL Recruitment 2026 permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: All 83 vacancies across administrative and technical disciplines are to be filled on a regular basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where will addenda or corrigenda regarding this recruitment be released?
faq.answer: Any addendum or corrigendum will be published solely on the official SCL website at www.scl.gov.in/career.html.
